UGREEN Hackathon 2026: Build AI Skills for a NAS

Online hackathon to build AI Skills for a NAS across four tracks. Round 1 needs a proposal of up to 500 words plus a test Skill; no NAS needed to enter.

PRIZE POOL
$46,000
Reward details
US$46,000 cash: 1st US$20,000, 2nd US$10,000, 3rd US$6,000, two Most Creative awards US$5,000 each.
Round 1 closes (15 Nov 23:45 PT)
16 Nov 2026, 13:15 IST
Format & location
Online · Worldwide
Who can apply
Individuals of legal age or teams of up to 3, from countries in the official rules; organisations cannot enter; Brazil, China and Quebec excluded.
Team size
1–3 participants

Entry notes

  • Up to 30 finalists announced 21 Nov; final Skills and demo videos due 30 Nov.
  • AI
  • NAS
  • Hardware
  • Skills
